\begin{lemma}[Every actual target point has the whole original fixed-flattening stalk dictionary]
\label{hir:real-domain-fixed-flattening-all-original-whole-stalks}
\source{bierstone-milman08-functoriality}
\uses{hir:real-centre-domain-original-pullback-coherence,hir:real-centre-domain-whole-nearby-translated-ideals,hir:nonlinear-nearby-actual-generator-transport,hir:nonlinear-nearby-original-whole-stalk-dictionary}
\lean{TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.HironakaSmoothCentreRealDomainOriginalStalkFreeness.whole_original_stalk_dictionary_at_actual_target}
\leanok
Let the original ideal be coherent and fix ANY genuine flattening whose
source lies in the real original chart target. At EVERY actual point of
this fixed flattening target, the entire actual translated flattened ideal
maps under the genuine recentered nonlinear germ equivalence to the WHOLE
original fixed-chart stalk ideal at the actual inverse image point. Its
whole inverse ideal image is the corresponding entire comap. No different
flattening, nearby ideal-map witness or global model coherence is assumed.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
At the actual inverse image point choose the original coherent ideal's true
finite holomorphic generators and complete local membership span. The real
inverse chart is holomorphic at every point of the actual flattening target.
Its actual pullback generators therefore present the existing flattened
ideal on a genuine smaller open containing the stated target point and
mapping into the original generator domain. Translate these ACTUAL functions
at that point to zero. The real finite-generator translation dictionary
identifies their entire ideal span with the WHOLE translated flattened
origin ideal. The true original finite-generator dictionary in the fixed
chart identifies its WHOLE original stalk with the entire chart-germ span
of the same original functions. The actual recentered nonlinear germ
equivalence maps each translated composite function germ to its true
original chart-function germ. Mapping every finite ideal sum in both
directions therefore gives the whole ideal image equality. The nonlinear
germ map is a genuine ring equivalence, so applying its comap gives the
entire inverse ideal equality. This argument is local at each actual point
of one fixed target and asserts nothing outside that real domain.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Every true local complex algebra equivalence preserves all original ambient jet quotients]
\label{hir:smooth-centre-actual-whole-ambient-jet-transport}
\lean{TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.HironakaSmoothCentreRealDomainActualAmbientHS.actualLocalAmbientJetAlgEquiv,TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.HironakaSmoothCentreRealDomainActualAmbientHS.actualLocalAmbientJetAlgEquiv_mk,TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.HironakaSmoothCentreRealDomainActualAmbientHS.actualAmbientHS_eq_of_genuineAlgEquiv}
\leanok
For every genuine complex algebra equivalence $E:R\simeq_{\mathbb C}S$
between actual local complex germ algebras, every original ideal $I$ and
every $s\geq0$, it gives a genuine complex algebra isomorphism
$R/(I+\mathfrak m_R^s)\simeq_{\mathbb C}
S/(E(I)+\mathfrak m_S^s)$. Every original numerator maps to its SAME
actual $E$ image. Thus the actual ambient Hilbert--Samuel values agree at
every order.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
An actual ring equivalence preserves units and nonunits in both directions.
The unique original maximal ideals therefore satisfy
$E(\mathfrak m_R)=\mathfrak m_S$. The true whole ideal map preserves powers
and sums, giving the full denominator image equality. The genuine quotient
algebra universal property constructs the whole complex algebra isomorphism,
with its inverse induced by the SAME original inverse map. Its actual
quotient formula retains every original representative. Restricting its
original algebra action to complex scalars proves equality of actual complex
dimensions. Apply this at exponent $s=\ell+1$ to the existing ambient
Hilbert--Samuel definition.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[A fixed real nonlinear flattening retains the actual original chart-stalk ambient function]
\label{hir:smooth-centre-fixed-real-original-ambient-hs-dictionary}
\uses{hir:smooth-centre-actual-whole-ambient-jet-transport,hir:real-domain-fixed-flattening-all-original-whole-stalks}
\lean{TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.HironakaSmoothCentreRealDomainActualAmbientHS.fixed_real_original_whole_stalk_ambient_hs_dictionary}
\leanok
For the actual original coherent ideal $A$, a fixed genuine flattening
$\Phi$, every actual target point $a\in\Phi.\mathrm{target}$ and original
point $y=\Phi^{-1}(a)$ in its true chart source, the actual translated
flattened origin ideal $I_a$ and the WHOLE original chart-stalk ideal
$A_y$ have identical ambient Hilbert--Samuel functions at all orders.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Use the actual original whole stalk map and comap dictionary, constructed
from genuine finite original coherent generators and their true nonlinear
holomorphic images on the real target. The genuine recentered nonlinear
germ equivalence maps the entire original $I_a$ onto the original $A_y$.
Apply the preceding whole maximal-power quotient transport. Its whole
complex scalar map is the actual original germ pullback. No finite jet,
ideal equality or Hilbert--Samuel comparison is supplied by a caller.
\end{proof}
